rationale.model_name: Use a Korean BERT-family checkpoint as the first Transformer baseline for Korean review text.
rationale.text_column: Use clean_review because pretrained Transformer tokenizers should see natural Korean text rather than Okt token strings.
rationale.max_length: 160 tokens keeps most short product reviews while reducing memory cost versus the 512-token maximum.
rationale.epochs: 3 epochs is a common fine-tuning starting point and limits overfitting on weak rule-based labels.
rationale.batch_size: 16 is a conservative BERT-base batch size for typical single-GPU memory; reduce to 8 if memory is tight.
rationale.learning_rate: 2e-5 is a standard small fine-tuning learning rate for pretrained BERT-style encoders.
rationale.weight_decay: 0.01 adds mild regularization for the classification head and encoder weights.
rationale.warmup_ratio: 0.1 stabilizes early fine-tuning before applying the full learning rate.
rationale.class_weight: balanced keeps the comparison aligned with existing imbalance experiments and protects minority neutral examples.
